create_InstanceToSemantic: create an InstanceToSemantic transform to convert instance segmentation masks to semantic segmentation targets
build_RecomputeBoxesFromMasks: build a RecomputeBoxesFromMasks transform to recompute bounding boxes and areas from binary mask tensors
test_DecodeRle: test the DecodeRle transform to decode RLE-encoded masks into uint8 binary segment tensors
refactor_InstanceToSemantic_delete: refactor InstanceToSemantic to optionally skip deleting instance segments after conversion
review_DecodeRle_resize: review the DecodeRle transform to handle size mismatches by resizing masks to match image dimensions
